summary: Patrol lookout two miles west of Willow Mountain, Ravalli County. No build or staffing record found; a 2010 fire of the same name is not linked to the lookout.

events.note: Dominic Point Fire, a wildfire with the same name: first reported July 25, 2010, about 14 miles northeast of Hamilton; approximately 700 to 1,000 acres by July 26 (NASA). No source read links this fire to the lookout site.

evidence.supports: patrol lookout located two miles west of Willow Mountain lookout
evidence.quote: A patrol lookout located at 2 miles west of Willow Mountain Lookout.

evidence.supports: Dominic Point Fire first reported July 25, 2010
evidence.quote: The Dominic Point Fire was first reported near 3:00 p.m. local time on Sunday, July 25, 2010.

evidence.supports: fire located about 14 miles northeast of Hamilton

evidence.supports: 700 to 1,000 acres burned by July 26, 2010, within the Bitterroot National Forest
evidence.quote: As of July 26, 2010, the fire had burned approximately 700 to 1,000 acres (283 to 405 hectares) of the Bitterroot National Forest in western Montana

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Forest Lookouts page (patrol lookout, two miles west of Willow Mountain, Bitterroot NF, Ravalli County). The cached FFLA Montana list has no Dominic Point entry. The 2010 fire shares the name but no source read ties it to the lookout site, so it appears only as an event with that caveat. Search snippets (not fetched, not cited) described Willow Mountain lookout being evacuated during a 2010 fire; that concerns Willow, not Dominic. Not yet checked: the Ray Kresek lookout book cited by the Forest Lookouts page, and Bitterroot NF records.
